payload.body_you: You tell {{holder1}} the money arrangement is uneven, you felt left out of the decision, or you are still angry about something the two of you stopped discussing. The relief comes from not pretending anymore.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} tells you where they feel excluded, resentful, jealous, or overburdened. The problem becomes clearer once {{holder1}} stops trying to make it sound smaller.
